The removal of P1.F6.H1's ingestion-ai block could indicate architectural simplification but lacks supporting implementation or test evidence in this group. Tier 3 requires demonstration across components or critical paths, which is absent. Tier 2 would require visible correctness checks or bounded capability improvement, not just config cleanup. This remains a maintenance/configuration adjustment with unverified benefit.

review.uncertainty: The true impact depends on whether ingestion can handle both event and AI lanes reliably, which cannot be established from configuration-only diffs.
